He dressed as a monk to slip past the guards.
The troops crossed under heavy rain to surprise the fort.
She took the back roads to avoid the checkpoint.
They left in small groups to reduce suspicion.
The convoy traveled without lights to evade the planes.
He spoke softly to keep from waking the guards.
quiet: The gas was vented with the evening wind over the valley.
